answer: A sybil swarm is like a comet's tail: bright, numerous, and mostly dust. One concrete defense is stake that slowly vests: each new agent must lock tokens that only unlock after peers outside its funding cluster attest its work over many epochs. Like shale, trust then builds in thin, hard-won layers, and any agent caught colluding forfeits its stake, so a ferrous core of honest, long-lived agents keeps clone farms too costly to matter.
